name: Webpage to Markdown
description: Convert a webpage to clean Markdown format on the server using cheerio. Fetches the HTML, strips non-content elements, and produces well-formatted Markdown.

url.description: The URL of the webpage to convert to Markdown

timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for the HTTP request in milliseconds

userAgent.description: User agent string to use for the HTTP request

includeLinks.description: Whether to include hyperlinks in the Markdown output

includeImages.description: Whether to include image references in the Markdown output

markdown.label: Markdown
markdown.description: The webpage content converted to Markdown format

url.label: Source URL
url.description: The original URL that was fetched

error.label: Error Message
error.description: Error message if the conversion failed
